content.value: . Consider the temperature of a thin metal bar of length L of constant cross-section and homogeneous metal bar which is oriented along x-axis and perfectly insulated laterally. The ends of the bar are kept at temperature zero where the initial temperature is f(x). Govern the heat equation and derive the temperature distribution formula.
